ops.text: ccx vcs stack restack, on a git-lane branch whose rebase conflicts, creates its conflict workspace inside the branch's own worktree (<worktree>/conflict-<branch>), and ccx vcs stack continue then refuses with '<worktree> has uncommitted work; no branches moved', the only untracked path being that conflict workspace. Seen on yasyf/cc-skills branch j6250-command-output-proves-command: continue resolved the commit (bbfd16e62) but would not move the branch until ccx vcs worktree rm removed the workspace, after which continue moved it and ccx vcs push had to publish it, since ship refused the rewrite. Fix: place the conflict workspace outside the worktree (beside it under ccx.worktreeRoot), or have the dirty-check ignore ccx's own conflict workspaces.
